nocore.description:
I worked on a payroll platform where users can enter their hours worked, allowing the employer to run the payroll.

I worked with ASP.NET MVC and an MSSQL database.

I provided second-line support to investigate issues encountered by customers, resolving them immediately where possible or creating Jira tickets to ensure they can be addressed in a future release.

I investigated the possibility of adding end-to-end tests to reduce the workload on testers by cutting down on manual testing. Following a demonstration, I implemented the initial tests.

whyellow.description:
I investigated the possibilites and limitations of location-based Augmented Reality using Google's ARCore within an Android app. As a demonstration of these capabilities, I developed an extension for an Anroid app that allows users to look around their surroundings using their phone's camera in the app and view logo's along with their distance from the user.

I used Kotlin for the Android app, and the project was managed using Scrum and all tasks were tracked in Jira.
